title: Summon-Shaped Recipes
description: Craft the spawn eggs of the iron golem, snow golem, copper golem, and wither.
body:
Ever wanted to craft all the summoning structures as a recipe to get the spawn egg? Well now you can! You could use it for anything such as trolling your friends :) All the recipes are shaped just like the structures to summom the entities.

List of all mobs you can obtain:
- Wither
- Iron Golem
- Snow Golem
- Copper Golem
